query:
-- Technology articles
UPDATE articles 
SET categoryId = (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE slug = 'technology' LIMIT 1)
WHERE slug IN (
  'empowering-theatre-production-students-with-computer-literacy'
);

-- Design Process articles
UPDATE articles 
SET categoryId = (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE slug = 'design-process' LIMIT 1)
WHERE slug IN (
  'navigating-the-scenic-design-process-a-comprehensive-guide',
  'you-re-wasting-my-time-a-scenic-design-lesson-in-growth-and-revision',
  'becoming-a-scenic-designer'
);

-- History articles
UPDATE articles 
SET categoryId = (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE slug = 'history' LIMIT 1)
WHERE slug IN (
  'opera-s-foundations-the-first-act-in-american-entertainment',
  'the-1960s-musical-revolution-when-hollywood-s-golden-formula-met-rock-and-rebellion',
  'video-game-environments'
);
